title: 714. Search in a Sorted Array of Unknown Size
hints: Adaptation: the array is supplied whole (sorted, bound 10000); out-of-range sentinel 2147483647 never needs reading.
Grow an index exponentially (1, 2, 4, 8, ...) until it passes the array end or the value reaches target, then binary-search that window.
A plain binary search over the whole array is also accepted and runs in O(log n).
